NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT APPLICATION

Applicant: 3352 N. Halsted Holding LLC

Property Location: 3350-3352 N. Halsted, Chicago, IL 60657
Proposed Zoning: C1-5 Neighborhood Commercial District
Lot Area: 6,250 square feet

3352 N. Halsted Holding LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type | Zoning Map Amendment for the
subject property located at 3350-3352 N. Halsted, Chicago, IL 60657. The Applicant requests a re-
zoning from the Cl-2 Neighborhood Commercial District to the C1-5 Neighborhood Commercial
District to build a 6-story mixed-use, 21-room hotel to allow for a restaurant and a hotel. The floor
area will be 30,084 square feet and building height at 75 feet.
The site is bounded by North Halsted Street; West Buckingham Place; the public alley west of and parallel
to North Halsted Street and West Roscoe Street. To the north is property zoned C1-2, to the east and
south are properties zoned C1-3 and to the west is property zoned RM-5.
NARRATIVE ZONING ANALYSIS
(a) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio:

i Lot area: 6,250 square feet

ii. Total proposed building area: 30,084 square feet

iii. Proposed FAR: 4.81
(c) Amount of off-street parking: 0

(d) Setbacks:

i. Rear (Ground Floor): 0

ii. Rear (Habitable Units): 0
(f) *Building Height: 15°
(g) **Loading Berth: None

As per Section 17-13-0303-D (Optional Administrative Adjustment/Variation)
* Administrative adjustment pursuant to Section 17-13-1003 (Height Adjustment)
**Variation pursuant to 17-13-1100 (Elimination of Required Loading Dock)

(continued on page 2)

1628767881 .2

The project complies with Section 17-3-0308 Specific Criteria for Transit-Served Locations.

1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B;

Response: The project complies with the standards of this Section. The subject property is located
within 2,640 feet of a CTA rail station and parking has been reduced by 100%.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504, except paragraph H as
the project is not located along a pedestrian street and except paragraph C if the land use is designated in a
non-commercial use group, pertaining to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even though the
project is not located along a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street;

Response: The project complies with the design standards of Section 17-3-0504, including
Sections 17-3-0504(C) and (H), as the property is located on a pedestrian street. The building
abuts the sidewalk, meets the transparency requirements, the doors and entrances are facing the
street.

3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide:
Station Area Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago
Plan Commission;

Response: N/A; No specific plans have been adopted by the Chicago Plan Commission for this
location.

4. The project does not have a number of parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum Automobile
Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-10-0207; and

Response: Confirmed; The project has less than 50% of the Minimum Automobile Parking Ratio
for the C1-5 Neighborhood Commercial District.

5. The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago
Department of Transportation.

Response: Confirmed; The project complies with CDOT Traffic Demand Study and Management
Plan rules.
